records.purpose: Authorise Google to send as tcgsouq.com.
records.note: LIVE VALUE DIFFERS: the zone currently ends -all (hard fail), not ~all. Google's own guidance is ~all, because SPF breaks on forwarding - the forwarding server's IP is never in the record - and -all invites receivers to reject legitimately forwarded mail outright. DKIM survives forwarding, so DMARC still catches real forgeries. -all also hard-rejects any future third-party sender until SPF is updated. The verifier flags this deliberately until it is changed or this manifest is corrected to match a deliberate choice.
